# Appendix B: NumPy Quick Reference

A practical desktop reference for everyday NumPy array operations in scientific computing.

## 1. Array Creation

| Command | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `np.array(list)` | Create array from list | `np.array([1, 2, 3])` |
| `np.zeros(shape)` | Array filled with zeros | `np.zeros((3, 3))` |
| `np.ones(shape)` | Array filled with ones | `np.ones(5)` |
| `np.full(shape, val)` | Array with constant value | `np.full((2, 2), 9.8)` |
| `np.arange(start, stop, step)`| Sequence with defined step | `np.arange(0, 10, 2)` |
| `np.linspace(start, stop, num)`| Evenly spaced points | `np.linspace(0, 1, 101)` |
| `np.eye(n)` | $n \times n$ Identity matrix | `np.eye(4)` |

## 2. Array Inspection and Reshaping

| Attribute / Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `arr.shape` | Tuple of array dimensions `(rows, cols)` |
| `arr.ndim` | Number of dimensions (1 for vector, 2 for matrix) |
| `arr.size` | Total number of elements |
| `arr.dtype` | Data type of elements (`float64`, `int32`, etc.) |
| `arr.reshape(rows, cols)` | Reshape into new dimensions |
| `arr.flatten()` | Flatten multi-dimensional array into 1D |
| `arr.T` | Transpose matrix (swap rows and columns) |

## 3. Mathematical and Statistical Reductions

| Function | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `arr.sum(axis=None)` | Sum of all elements (or along `axis=0` / `axis=1`) |
| `arr.mean(axis=None)` | Arithmetic mean |
| `arr.std(axis=None)` | Standard deviation |
| `arr.var(axis=None)` | Variance |
| `arr.min()`, `arr.max()`| Minimum and maximum values |
| `arr.argmin()`, `arr.argmax()` | Indices of min and max elements |
| `np.cumsum(arr)` | Cumulative sum array |

## 4. Stacking and Joining

| Function | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `np.vstack([A, B])` | Stack arrays vertically (row-wise) |
| `np.hstack([A, B])` | Stack arrays horizontally (column-wise) |
| `np.column_stack((x, y))`| Combine 1D vectors into 2D table columns |

## 5. Linear Algebra (`np.linalg`)

| Function | Mathematical Operation |
| :--- | :--- |
| `np.linalg.det(A)` | Determinant $\det(A)$ |
| `np.linalg.inv(A)` | Matrix Inverse $A^{-1}$ |
| `np.linalg.solve(A, b)` | Solve linear system $A \vec{x} = \vec{b}$ |
| `np.linalg.eig(A)` | Eigenvalues and eigenvectors |
| `A @ B` or `np.matmul(A, B)` | Matrix multiplication |
| `np.dot(u, v)` | Vector dot product |
